name: General music
description: Music facts that fit any channel, plus lines for the streamer's own compositions.
curatedFacts: Concert pitch of A = 440 Hz was adopted by the International Organization for Standardization in 1955.
A symphony orchestra is usually divided into strings, woodwinds, brass and percussion.
A metronome marks tempo in beats per minute.
The circle of fifths arranges the twelve pitch classes by perfect fifths.
A sonata is typically a multi-movement work for one or two instruments.
Equal temperament — the tuning nearly all modern keyboards use — is a deliberate compromise; no interval except the octave is perfectly in tune.
originalsFacts: This piece exists because someone sat down and wrote it, not because a studio commissioned it.
Original compositions on a request stream are rarer than you'd think — most request lists are all covers.
